info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Portfolio Management API
info.description: The Product Portfolio Management API allows businesses to refine and adjust their product offerings to better meet market demands. This API enables authorized users to modify existing product portfolio details, ensuring that information remains current and relevant. Use cases include updating product specifications, adjusting pricing strategies, and managing product lifecycle stages. Typical consumers of this API include business analysts and product managers seeking to enhance their offerings based on analytical insights.
